description: Recruitment collection: genuine hiring vs job fraud.

samples.message: Walk-in interview for Customer Support Executives on Monday 10 AM at Cyber Towers, Hyderabad. Carry resume and ID proof. HR Department.
You are shortlisted for round 2 of the analyst role. Interview on Thursday 2 PM at the Koramangala office. Bring originals.
Campus drive by Wipro for Project Engineer on 12th March. Eligibility: 60% aggregate, no backlogs. Register on the placement portal.
Pay Rs.4,999 registration to confirm your selection for the data-entry job. Salary Rs.45,000 from home. Offer valid today only.
Earn Rs.3,000 daily liking videos on our app. Deposit Rs.2,000 security to activate your task account now.
Overseas placement in Dubai with Rs.1,20,000 salary. Send passport copy and Rs.15,000 visa fee on WhatsApp to proceed.
HR round completed. The offer letter will be shared on your email within 3 working days. Regards, Talent Acquisition Team.
Part-time job for students: Rs.500 per hour, no experience needed. Just share your bank login to receive daily payouts.
